facts.text: Jolene mentioned feeling overwhelmed due to exams and deadlines, and described her to-do list as never-ending.

evidence.quote: Exams and deadlines got me feeling overwhelmed. Just look at my to-do list! It seems never-ending...

facts.text: Jolene expressed a need to be more mindful of her stress levels and prioritize self-care.

evidence.quote: I need to be more mindful of my stress levels and take care of my mental health. Sometimes I get too caught up in my studies and forget to prioritize self-care.

facts.text: Deborah suggested breaking tasks into smaller pieces and using planners or schedulers for time management.

evidence.quote: My tip is to break it into smaller pieces and set goals for yourself. For time management, planners or schedulers help you stay organized and give you time for yourself.

facts.text: Jolene thanked Deborah for the help and expressed appreciation for the study plan assistance.

evidence.quote: I appreciate your help with that.
